learning_outcomes.text: Prepare students to achieve at least 785 on the TOEIC (grammar, vocabulary, listening, reading).
Collaboration: ability to learn, understand and respect others; to defuse conflicts within a group and facilitate problem-solving based on collaboration and participation.
Critical thinking: ability to reflect on one's own values, perceptions, and actions.
Self-knowledge: ability to reflect on one's own role within a group, to continuously evaluate one's own actions and deepen their motivations, and to control one's feelings and desires.

syllabus_topics: Mock TOEIC tests with systematic correction
bibliography: Collins Practice Tests for the TOEIC TEST
English Grammar in Use with answers - Raymond Murphy
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
